title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for P_0(t) - bar{P}_0(t) must be correctly stated.

title: Probability Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The derivation of P_0(t) and bar{P}_0(t) must be shown clearly, including the use of the correct wave function.

title: Use of Definitions
description: Important Criteria: Definitions of tau_L, tau_S, gamma_L, and gamma_S must be correctly applied in the context of the problem.

title: Exponential Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The exponential decay terms in the probabilities should be correctly identified and simplified.

title: Cosine Factor
description: Optional Criteria: The cosine factor in the final expression should be derived and presented accurately.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing or incorrect signs in the cosine term or exponential decay factors will lead to a significant error.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the derivation, particularly in the context of energy and time.
